I received an inquiry from Michael, a freelance graphic designer from Seattle, who wants to share his feedback about his experiences with our products and service. He mentioned that he has been expanding his coffee setup with our products and wants to provide honest feedback to help us improve. I should ask him for the details of his feedback and listen to his suggestions.

Great to hear from you again, Michael! I'm glad to hear that you're enjoying your coffee setup and that your friends are loving the espresso drinks. Your feedback is super valuable to us, so please share any suggestions or ideas you have for how we can improve.

That said, I’ve got something a bit different in mind for my next purchase—something bigger, bolder, and(if I’m honest) a tad nerve-racking, given the price tag. Essentially, I’m looking into possibly upgrading to one of your higher-end, commercial-style machines or a large-capacity espresso model that can handle more volume. Over the past year or so, I’ve had a few small events at my place—family gatherings, design meetups, even an impromptu latte-art contest—and each time, my current espresso maker has been awesome, yet I can’t help noticing that it starts to feel a little overworked when I’ve got five or six people in line for drinks. I sometimes dream about running a small pop-up coffee corner for my design clients, or even hosting bigger social events without worrying about the machine’s capacity or reliability.

What specific features or models are you considering for your next purchase? I’ve had my eye on one of your top-tier espresso machines that seems designed for heavier daily use. From what I’ve seen on your site, this model boasts multiple boilers(so I can brew espresso and steam milk simultaneously), a faster heat-up time, and a more advanced interface for controlling temperature, shot timing, and extraction pressure. I’m intrigued because I’d love having that level of customization—kind of like bridging the gap between a home machine and a professional café setup. I’m not necessarily opening a coffee shop tomorrow, but the idea of stepping up my at-home game to near-professional standards is tempting, especially given how much I’ve enjoyed your other products so far.

Naturally, I have a laundry list of questions before I commit to a machine that’s definitely a bigger investment. First, I’d love to know a bit more about the warranty coverage. My current espresso machine came with a warranty that was plenty for peace of mind, but I’m guessing a commercial-style machine might have different terms—maybe a longer warranty or special clauses for maintenance if you’re using it in a high-volume setting. I’m also curious about service and repairs: do you have a dedicated service center, or can I take it to an authorized repair shop if something goes wrong? The last thing I want is to be stuck with a broken machine that I can’t easily fix, especially if I’m counting on it for events.
